body: there is an issue with [tmp folder not being cleaned up properly #4441](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/4441) which might be related. can you verify that you can repro this issue with tmp folder manually removed?

Some more observations:
- `karma start karma-js.conf.js` works
- `gulp test.unit.js/ci` works when commenting out the `./tools/check-environment` part: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/gulpfile.js#L47-L50
- `gulp test.unit.js` works when commenting out the watcher part: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/gulpfile.js#L601-L606

Could it be some kind of race condition on the filesystem access?

I don't know.

commenting out `./tools/check-environment` helps? that's really odd. can
you trace it what inside of check-environment is causing the problem? that
could give us some hints..

body:
@mlaval Your patch worked perfectly for me, thanks!

Is there any possibility of adding this patch to the master branch to fix the situation until karma/graceful-fs/node get's fixed? It's a little bit of a pain having that file always dirty in the local folder, but anyway is something I can live with, I guess (sigh).

BTW just in case it gives you some more clues, what I was doing to run the tests (before applying your patch that is a lot much better), was watching only the `gulpfile.js` instead of the full modules folder. This way it runs, so it seems like there are still some file handles avail (at least one :-) )....

Sorry for bumping this issue, but just upgraded to a.44 and I ran into this issue (prior to a.44 this didn't happen to me). I tried @mlaval patch but doesn't work for me, instead of failing and crashing, it just throws the error message, pass it and gets stuck in a posterior step, here's part of the log http://pastebin.com/N0CZzPUm (It just get stuck in the last line). I even tried with giving more time to the setTimeout). I'm under Ubuntu 14.04.2 LTS (a VM, fwiw)

**Edit**
I just followed this comment https://github.com/Workiva/karma-jspm/issues/97#issuecomment-141188324, also I removed the patch.

I edited `/etc/security/limits.conf` and added (rebooted after this)

```
* soft nofile 40000
* hard nofile 40000
```

Now it's working correctly

On Windows, still the same situation with latest master.
Upgrading to node 4.2.1 doesn't help

Marc, let's debug this after Angular Connect when I'm at your office.
